decisions.decision: Skip group IDs when building conflicting subcommand list to avoid panic.
decisions.rationale: The parser previously called `unwrap()` on `self.cmd.find(id)`, which returns `None` for group IDs, causing a panic. Filtering them out prevents the panic and still reports the conflict.
decisions.quote: Don't panic when subcommands conflict with groups

alternatives.alternative: Call `unwrap()` on `self.cmd.find(id)` to get the argument name.
alternatives.reason: It panics when `self.cmd.find(id)` returns `None` for group IDs.

consequences.text: Filtering out group IDs prevents the unwrap panic while still reporting the conflict.
consequences.quote: Don't panic when subcommands conflict with groups
